previous_evidence.excerpt:
Made pandan chiffon cake this morning. The kitchen smelled good for hours and I sat at the table eating a slice with hot Milo before anyone else was up. It was nice.

Response: Everything becomes about what needs doing next.
I said yes obviously. But it means I'll miss the CNY market at Chinatown with Mei and Hwee Leng.

current_evidence.excerpt: I wanted to take a long bath — the kind with the lavender salts my friend gave me for my birthday — but the bathroom still needed cleaning from the kids using it, and by the time I finished scrubbing...
I know a massage would help. I know lying down with a heat pad for an hour would help. But I keep hearing my mother's voice in my head telling me not to be so pampered, that at her age...
